title: Stablecoin Holdings Classification Register
description: Extension schema for the vwp-digital-assets-stablecoin extension: the register at facts/stablecoin-holdings.json. One entry per stablecoin holding with the redemption right the holder actually has, the evidence for it, the balance-sheet classification concluded and the judgment that concluded it. The validators check that every holding links a resolvable classification judgment, that cash-like classifications rest on evidenced redemption rights, and that the same token from the same issuer is classified consistently.

redemptionRight.description: Whether the reporting entity itself can redeem with the issuer at par, can only redeem through an intermediary, or has no redemption right.

redemptionTermsEvidence.description: Evidence ids for the issuer terms establishing the redemption right.

reserveEvidence.description: Evidence ids for reserve attestations or audits.
